items.text: moving stickers. In Capture's sticker shelf, Still or Moving: Moving records three seconds of the field inside the duck-rabbit, with its frame and extras, clear outside, looping without a seam, 600 px at 15 fps. A GIF by default; the share sheet writes the same sticker again as APNG (a soft edge, for iMessage and Telegram) or WebP (512 square under 500 KB, for WhatsApp) without recording again, and shows its size
the share sheet's "make it as" row has Moving, so a GIF, a still or a sticker becomes a moving sticker (the sheet steps aside while it records), and a moving sticker becomes a still one on the spot
the live sticker preview says "moving" when Moving is on

Settings has a Performing switch. On, nothing reloads by itself mid-show, the update notice waits until you turn it off, and the screen stays awake. It is also on by itself while you are in a room, or while auto play runs in fullscreen
auto play keeps the screen awake while it runs
a shared scene, a pack or a room can only bring colors, settings and words, never anything that runs on the page
bytebeat formulas from packs, links and files are read by Current's own formula reader and never run as code; a formula it cannot read is refused with a note
opening Current no longer keeps a copy of the scene online; a scene link is made only when you open the cards or ask for a link
on a slow or stuck connection Current opens from what it kept within a few seconds, instead of waiting
the visitor count no longer sees a shared scene's link or a room's code

now and then, when there is no update, a word from the studio in the update's place: a question to answer, news, or a call for artists and volunteers. At most once every few days, never in the first minute, never while the robot, a recording or the bare stage is running
Settings has a News switch (Off / On) for the studio's questions and news

your own recordings in the kit. Import wav, mp3, ogg, m4a or flac files (several at once, a folder on a laptop, or drop them on the open kit): each becomes a sound, under 3 s a one-shot, longer a loop that holds, and plays by touch, on the beat, as a bed or from the pattern

sound packs with recordings. A pack zip (pack.json, instrument.json, samples/) opens from kit › Import… or dropped anywhere on Current, with each sound's role already set; Save as a set saves one, recordings included, to share
recordings stay on this device, so your kit is there next time
the Sound section links the sound pack guide, with a starter pack of water sounds and a template (made for the Frost Electronic Music Ensemble)
kit sounds playing on their own (a bed, a beat or a pattern with the beat off) now move the field and light the speaker
in the update notes, NEW / FIX / CHANGE sit on the same line as the note's words
in the light theme the dice's amount ring is a dark teal on a white track, so it reads on the white bar
the notes in the update notice and under Version show their kind in words again, NEW · FIX · CHANGE, beside the icon
the share sheet asks what to make it as: still · video · GIF · sticker. A still or a sticker is remade on the spot from the stage; video and GIF step the sheet aside and start recording
